meta.targetWindow: 15–22 Feb 2027 (7 nights, Mon–Mon). Preferred short window 15–18 Feb 2027 is only 3 nights.
meta.bookingReality: Correction to the earlier note (2026-11-25, second session): dated rates for 15-22 Feb 2027 ARE obtainable from third-party booking engines. Michelin's own hotel widget enforces a 31-day advance limit, but Booking.com returned live 7-night totals for the exact dates, recorded below with the capture date and exact rate URL. No hotel's own booking engine was read directly, so these are dated aggregator snapshots, not hotel quotes.
meta.rankingPolicy: Ranking uses only verified attributes (published Michelin Keys/guest score, address/area, published room features). No unverified travel-time score is presented as fact.
meta.ratePolicy: publishedRate = undated 'from' rate on an official page. sevenNightTotal = live total for 2027-02-15 to 2027-02-22, 2 adults, captured 2026-11-25, pre-tax as quoted; tax lines and the all-in arithmetic are in taxBasis and allInSevenNights. Never mix the two columns.
